Tessa —

Finance position (preliminary): We can provisionally approve a pilot-level Net-90 with the following conditions to mitigate cashflow and revenue recognition risk:

1) Discount capped at 10% for the pilot period (vs requested 15%).
2) Customer must sign a short payment schedule accepting quarterly invoicing and authorizing the PO to be applied to the quarter in which usage is recorded.
3) Redwood to treat the 10% as a conditional rebate recorded against revenue; payment will be made as a credit on the subsequent invoice after usage verification.
4) Require ACH details and a billing contact to expedite collections if the invoice ages beyond 60 days.

Please run this by legal for the clause language. If legal approves, Marissa, I think this can be signed off at director level; if legal asks for tighter controls we should route to CFO for exec signoff.
